video.title: 穿进龙族霸权，兄妹系统拿反了/Sucked into Dragon Hegemony,the Siblings Get the Wrong Systems
video.desc:
不给他放欧腐 但有相关情节 穿越的故事
Investment banking executive Lyra and her physicist brother are sucked into a fantasy game, where dragons rule mankind. But they get the wrong systems: Lyra must survive by burning through money with the Spendthrift System, while her straight brother gets stuck with the Romance System. He must win over an unstable Black Dragon Monarch!
投行高管 Lyra 和她的物理学家哥哥 Liam，被吸进了一个巨龙统治人类的奇幻游戏世界。偏偏兄妹俩拿错了系统：Lyra 必须靠"败家系统"疯狂花钱才能活下去，而她那个直男哥哥，却被"恋爱系统"缠上了——他的任务是，攻略一位喜怒无常的黑龙君主！
